summary: The call is a customer support interaction between Benjamin (customer) and Jorgen (agent) discussing the withdrawal of funds from Atomic Wallet, the associated fees (around $27,000), tax implications (capital gains vs. income tax in Canada), and the possibility of transferring the crypto to another exchange (EdEx/Index) to handle taxes independently.
minutes: Benjamin inquired about a $27,000 fee for withdrawing funds from Atomic and whether it includes Canadian income taxes.
Jorgen clarified that the tax would be capital gains tax, not income tax, since Benjamin is not a day trader.
They discussed the option of transferring the cryptocurrency directly to another exchange (EdEx/Index/Nordex) to bypass the fiat withdrawal and handle the tax implications independently.
Jorgen advised Benjamin to contact Atomic Support to clarify the refund process, confirm if the fee includes taxes, and ask if a direct crypto transfer to another exchange is possible.
key_decisions: Benjamin will contact Atomic to explore the alternative transfer method to another exchange.

action_items.task: Contact Atomic to confirm the refund process and if the transfer can be made directly to a Canadian bank account or another exchange.
Inquire whether the Atomic fee includes taxes and how it will be justified.
